newsitem.title: TURKEY: 27 dead in Turkey heatwave accidents.
newsitem.headline: 27 dead in Turkey heatwave accidents.

text.p: Twenty-seven people have died in accidents while trying to cool off in a heatwave sweeping the southeast of Turkey for the last two weeks, Anatolian news agency said on Friday.
Eighteen people have drowned as spiralling temperatures of more than 40 degrees Celsius (104 Fahrenheit) have sent the population heading for rivers and lakes, the agency said.

A further nine have died and seven have been injured after falling off roofs in their sleep. They, like many in the area, decided to spend the night on top of their houses in an effort to stay cool, it said.
